description:
Deploy a repo of custom Odoo modules to a STAGING instance and run Odoo's test
    upgrade there. Targets the extra instance named by `staging_slug` (must already
    exist). On confirm: (a) ensure its git dir is on its addons_path (idempotent), (b)
    checkout repo@ref into the staging git dir as the odoo user (deploy key/token via
    key_file/ZX_GIT_KEY_FILE - never inline in the transcript; auth='' for a public
    repo), (c) run `odoo -u <modules|discovered> --test-enable --stop-after-init
    --workers=0 --no-http` on the STAGING db, (d) parse pass/fail. On green, RECORD the
    exact commit → modules as staging-green in the code-state (so it may later be
    promoted to prod). dry_run (default) returns the exact bash + resolved plan and
    touches NOTHING.
name: code_deploy_staging
